note: Transcription of the two published TorchSSL cells this acceptance audits, NOT of any recomputation. Values were read off the CIFAR-10 block of the 'Main Results' table in TorchSSL/TorchSSL's README.md at clone commit f26e1d42967cec7f7c8a00c2e7ff9219d8ab7c92; the column assignment was verified against the header row ('40', '250', '4000' under CIFAR-10) and the row assignment against the method name in the first column. This file is an audit input only: experiment-doctor recomputes every number from the run logs and compares them with these cells.

source.table: README.md 'Main Results' > '### CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100', CIFAR-10 / 250 labels column
source.plus_minus_semantics: README.md:58 calls the published '+/-' 'standard errors'. The project's own aggregation script (scripts/average_log.py:132) writes 'round(np.mean(values),2) + U+00B1 + round(np.std(values),2)', where np.std is the population standard deviation (default ddof=0) over the seed group, not std/sqrt(N). The prose and the code disagree; this transcription records the printed digits, and the audit's spread_basis declaration decides which recomputation is compared with them.
source.reported_basis: percent accuracy (scripts/average_log.py:92 multiplies the logged fraction by 100 before aggregating)
source.seed_set_claim: README.md:58 states random seeds 0,1,2 were used for all experiments
